title: Dot the Dog
checkpoint: After s, a, t, p, i, n, m, d, g, o, c, k, ck (Learning — Phase 2, sounds 1-13)
note_for_grown_ups: A brand new character, Dot the dog, is introduced here — her name is fully decodable (d-o-t) with the sounds taught so far.

pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow perched on a fence post next to an enormous soppy brown dog with a white patch over one eye — Dot. The size difference is the whole joke. Bright, friendly.
Dot sitting square on the grass in the classic obedient-dog pose, tail sweeping a fan-shape in the daisies, tongue out. Simple and full of character.
Dot squashed onto a small stripy doormat far too little for her, paws hanging off all four sides. Pip watching from the doorstep, unimpressed.
Pip standing on Dot's broad head patting her between the ears with one wing. Dot's eyes are shut in absolute bliss. Warm and tender.

pages.text: Dot digs. Dot digs a pit.
pages.illustration: Dot digging furiously, back end up, earth flying in an arc behind her, a growing hole in the flowerbed. Pip leaping clear of the flying soil.
Closing page: Dot asleep in the sunny hole she dug, Pip asleep on her side, both rising and falling together. Late golden light, deep contentment.
